Adds Upstream pool as an explicit policy for port forwarding rules, with weighted targets and compact domain/IP grouping. Native DNAT supports round robin, random and source-IP hashing; custom adapter contract 2 supports declared balancing, backup, failure-exclusion and connection-retry options.

Fixes explicit Reapply work dispatch and reconnect repair being skipped when saved configuration is unchanged. Existing Port mapping rules retain their lifecycle and behavior.

Update the server, frontend and affected agents before using pools or adapter contract 2; these require forwarding schema 3 and command protocol 12. Migration 0029 adds optional pool data while preserving existing rules. Custom adapters must implement the documented contract; no adapter executable is bundled.

Updates frontend TOML parsing and source-map dependencies to address dependency audit findings.
